title: The flats, the last February
logline: The flats in the last February, wind, the pup walking, the man matching, from behind, the chimney, and the page as plain as the run's first walk in 1999. The private work at its most ordinary, three weeks before the mornings.

panels.composition: Gray mudflats in wind with an old three-legged dog walking and a man in plaid matching its pace from behind, the chimney far off, plain.
